# airdrop_secretreveal (Ephemeral Resource)

Reveals the unmasked data of a Secret. Unlike the `airdrop_secretreveal` data source, the data is not stored in the plan or state.

## Example Usage

```terraform
ephemeral "airdrop_secretreveal" "database" {
  metadata {
    namespace = "default"
    name      = "database"
  }
}

# The secret data is not stored in the plan or state.
provider "postgresql" {
  host     = "db.example.com"
  username = ephemeral.airdrop_secretreveal.database.string_data["username"]
  password = ephemeral.airdrop_secretreveal.database.string_data["password"]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `metadata` (Block List) Metadata of the Secret to reveal. Exactly one block is required. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--metadata))

### Read-Only

- `data` (Map of String, Sensitive) Secret data. Values are base64 encoded.
- `data_json` (String, Sensitive) JSON encoded representation of the data field.
- `string_data` (Map of String, Sensitive) Base64 decoded representation of the data field.
- `string_data_json` (String, Sensitive) JSON encoded representation of the base64 decoded data field.
- `type` (String) Secret type.

<a id="nestedblock--metadata"></a>
### Nested Schema for `metadata`

Required:

- `name` (String) Name of the Secret.
- `namespace` (String) Namespace of the Secret.
